local_adaptation.window: Native chooseButton/choosePlayerCard/gainPlayerCard/discardPlayerCard with an actual card/vcard window map the existing confirm nodes to the common round window buttons. Character/faction selection and character browsers are excluded. No confirm or cancel is invented when the engine does not create one.
local_adaptation.regular: Ordinary use/respond/discard, skill card/target selection, plain chooseBool activation asks, and redraw retain existing normal/redraw branches. Event changes remove markers and restore the original button layout.
local_adaptation.layout: Official card windows reserve their existing150-unit footer; buttons are centered relative to the stable dialog bounds, bottom40, gap50, following scene zoom. A legacy dialog with official loading frame disabled has no footer reserve, so place buttons20 units below its content; this fallback is a local compatibility choice, not an official coordinate.
local_adaptation.lifecycle: Coalesced event/DOM/resize updates, no continuous animation loop; native dialog collapse/restore, confirm animation and engine confirm/cancel semantics are preserved.
